scope.zh: 新建的“考古发掘意外”故事族：通用事件池 all_random_events 及其子池、各事件脚本与中英文文本；替代原先每个事件一个孤立故事的草稿。
scope.en: New curated family of excavation incidents: the generic pool all_random_events and its sub-pools, each incident script and both languages; replaces the draft of one isolated story per incident.

uncertain: The family title reuses the original UI string ARCHAEOLOGICAL_SITE_PLURAL (考古遗址 / Archaeological Sites) because the game has no name for the incident pool.
Site-specific pools (e.g. engineered species, ocean sites, Genius Caeli, fungus dig) change which incidents are possible at a given site; they are noted in the site guides, not modelled here.

label.zh: 发掘失利时的随机事件池
label.en: The pool of random excavation incidents

note.zh: 某一发掘阶段掷骰得分≤5且该阶段已有线索时，有10/130的机会从事件池中抽一个；不同遗址可能使用专属事件池。各事件相互独立，没有先后。
note.en: When an excavation roll scores 5 or less and the stage already has clues, there is a 10/130 chance to draw one incident from the pool; some sites use their own pools. Incidents are independent and unordered.

label.zh: 敌对野生动物：四种结果

note.en: site_explosive_decompression (common/scripted_effects/archaeology_event_effects.txt:542) draws one at 5/25/25/25 (no 8200 for a robotic leader, no 8201 for a robotic owner species). It is called from the orbital/spaceship pools space_station_random_events and site_spaceship_random_events.

texts.zh: 一场甲烷爆炸事件夺去了科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]及其他几位工作人员的性命。原因是一个失控的钻头使得发电机组过载并引发火灾引发爆炸。失控的火灾点燃了剩余的甲烷并炸倒了一堵墙，结果使得一个由许多厅室和隧道组成的建筑系统重见天日。考古学家们确信这些遗址曾经属于一位藏有大量的珍奇珠宝和文物的富人。
texts.en: A methane gas explosion has injured Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and several of the crew. The blast set off when a malfunctioning drill overcharged the generators which then caught fire. Before the fire could be contained it ignited some residual methane gas and tore down a wall, revealing a secret system of chambers and tunnels. Our archaeologists believe they may have belonged to a person of means and note as they were filled to the brim with precious minerals and artifacts.

notes.zh: 事件池中“石中低语”的专属事件：在石灵遗址权重20；在其他遗址只要尚未触发过也可抽中（设置 triggered_lithoids_special_event 后仅限石灵遗址）。科学家致残，获得矿物、稀有水晶和大量文物。
notes.en: The Whispers in the Stone special: weight 20 at the lithoid site; at other sites only until it has fired once (triggered_lithoids_special_event). The scientist is maimed; minerals, rare crystals and artifacts are gained.

texts.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]试图从一堆各种各样的瓦砾中取出一件可能有价值的东西时，意外地引发了垃圾雪崩。我们在被埋在下面的时候，发现了一个非常小的、像老鼠一样的黑色动物残骸，它紧紧抱着一瓶商标为[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesMouthName]洗洁精，仿佛要保护它免受伤害一样。在这堆杂物中还有一个小箱子，里面装满了来自星涯海角的珍贵外星文物。
texts.en: When attempting to extract an item of interest from a pile of assorted bric-a-brac, [Root.GetLeaderName] accidentally set a junk avalanche in motion. Buried underneath it, we discovered the sooty remains of a tiny ratlike creature cradling a bottle of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesMouthName]wash from a brand common on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName], as if shielding it from harm. Amongst the clutter was also a tiny chest filled with precious alien artifacts from distant corners of the galaxy.

notes.zh: 事件池中“誊录仪”的专属事件：在誊录仪遗址权重20；在其他遗址只要尚未触发过也可抽中（triggered_rubricator_random_event）。
notes.en: The Rubricator special: weight 20 at its own site; elsewhere only until it has fired once (triggered_rubricator_random_event).

texts.zh: 入夜后，正当考古学家们酣眠之时，营地的食品模块突然因食物烧糊而发生火灾。此外没有找到有关火灾发生原因的线索。幸而无人受伤，可考古学家们空着肚子是无法好好工作的……
texts.en: Overnight, as the archaeologists slept peacefully, a fire broke out in the camp's provisions module overcooking the food somewhat. There are no indications as to how the fire started. Luckily no one was harmed, but archaeologists do not work well on an empty stomach...

label.en: A true [owner.GetSpeciesName] lives off the land.

notes.zh: 仅非格式塔且使用食物的帝国，每个帝国一次（triggered_sentinels_random_event）。
notes.en: Only for non-gestalt, food-using empires; once per empire (triggered_sentinels_random_event).

texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

激光网迅速移动，将[dead_scientist.GetName]和另外几名[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]切成了碎片。
texts.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

The rapidly moving laser beams sliced [dead_scientist.GetName] and several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] into tiny pieces.

texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

几名[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]被快速移动的网格切成了碎片。尽管[Root.GetLeaderName]安然无恙，这些损失还是对项目产生了重大的不利影响。
texts.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were sliced into tiny pieces by the fast moving beams. Although [Root.GetLeaderName] survived unscathed, these losses have had a negative impact on the project.

texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

很幸运，多亏了[Root.GetLeaderName]的快速行动，激光在造成任何损失之前被无效化了。项目进度向前推进，超出了预期。
texts.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

Fortunately, thanks to the quick actions of [Root.GetLeaderName] the lasers were disabled before they could cause any harm. The project is moving forwards, ahead of schedule.

texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上考古遗址疏散的过程中，一个古老但仍可工作的激光网在无意间被触发。

激光挡住了前进的唯一道路。无效化它们的代价很昂贵，但要找到另一条绕过激光网的路则会耗费很多时间。
texts.en:
During the excavations of the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], an ancient but still functional laser grid was inadvertently triggered.

The lasers are blocking the only path forward. Disabling them will be expensive, but finding an alternative route around the laser grid would take a lot of time.

label.en: They will have to go around.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然间触发了一个年代久远但仍能运作的哨戒炮阵列。

自动炮台在被关闭之前迅速地射杀了[dead_scientist.GetName]和其他几个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] accidentally triggered an array of ancient but still functional sentry guns.

The automated guns rapidly mowed down [dead_scientist.GetName] and several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] before they could be disabled.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然间触发了一个年代久远但仍能运作的哨戒炮阵列。

几个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]被困于他们的交火区域。[Root.GetLeaderName]最终设法关闭了那些炮台，但死伤不可避免。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] accidentally triggered an array of ancient but still functional sentry guns.

Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were caught in their firing zones. [Root.GetLeaderName] eventually managed to disable the guns, but there were several fatalities.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然间触发了一个年代久远但仍能运作的哨戒炮阵列。

很幸运，[Root.GetLeaderName]设法在有人受伤之前解除了那些自动炮台。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] accidentally triggered an array of ancient but still functional sentry guns.

Fortunately, [Root.GetLeaderName] managed to disable the automated guns before anyone was harmed.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然间触发了一个年代久远但仍能运作的哨戒炮阵列。

没有人受伤，但炮台挡住了前进的唯一道路。如果它们不能被解除，我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]将不得不寻找另一条路线。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] accidentally triggered an array of ancient but still functional sentry guns.

No one was harmed, but the guns are blocking the only way forwards. If they can't be disabled, our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] will have to find an alternate route.

label.en: They will have to go around.

texts.zh:
一台四处徘徊的，被设置用来埋伏粗心探险家们的碾轧机器人，被我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]撞上了。

在暴走停下来之前，古老的半感性机器人将[dead_scientist.GetName]碾成了肉末。
texts.en:
A roving crusher-droid, set up to ambush unwary explorers, was encountered by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName].

The ancient and semi-sentient robot ground [dead_scientist.GetName] into tiny pieces before its rampage could be stopped.

texts.zh:
一台四处徘徊的，被设置用来埋伏粗心探险家们的碾轧机器人，被我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]撞上了。

[Root.GetLeaderName]设法从暴走的机器人手上捡回一条小命，但其他的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]就没那么幸运了。
texts.en:
A roving crusher-droid, set up to ambush unwary explorers, was encountered by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName].

[Root.GetLeaderName] managed to flee its rampage, but several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were not so lucky.

texts.zh:
一台四处徘徊的，被设置用来埋伏粗心探险家们的碾轧机器人，被我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]撞上了。

凭借着经验和一点点运气，[Root.GetLeaderName]设法在任何人受伤之前平息了机器人的暴走。
texts.en:
A roving crusher-droid, set up to ambush unwary explorers, was encountered by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName].

With skill and a fair bit of luck, [Root.GetLeaderName] managed to halt the rampaging robot before anyone was injured.

texts.zh:
一台四处徘徊的，被设置用来埋伏粗心探险家们的碾轧机器人，被我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]撞上了。

每个人都想避开暴走的机器人，但它昼夜不停的在我们前进的唯一道路上巡逻。如果不能关掉它，我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]只能去寻找其他的路。
texts.en:
A roving crusher-droid, set up to ambush unwary explorers, was encountered by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName].

Everyone managed to escape the rampaging robot, but it is now tirelessly patrolling the only way forward. Unless it can be disabled, our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] will have to look for another path.

label.en: They will have to go around.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行考古发掘的时候莫名其妙地激活了一些远古智能人。

这些敌对智能人在被武器火力干掉之前迅速解决了[dead_scientist.GetName]。
texts.en:
The excavations carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] have somehow activated several ancient sentinel droids.

The hostile robots made short work of [dead_scientist.GetName] before they could be permanently deactivated with weapons fire.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行考古发掘的时候莫名其妙地激活了一些远古智能人。

敌对智能人在被[Root.GetLeaderName]阻止之前成功干掉了一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]。
texts.en:
The excavations carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] have somehow activated several ancient sentinel droids.

The hostile robots managed to kill several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] before they could be stopped by [Root.GetLeaderName].

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行考古发掘的时候莫名其妙地激活了一些远古智能人。

万幸的是[Root.GetLeaderName]与附近的安保人员在这些敌对智能人严重伤人之前就关闭了它们。
texts.en:
The excavations carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] have somehow activated several ancient sentinel droids.

Luckily, [Root.GetLeaderName] and the nearby security escort managed to neutralize the hostile robots before they could seriously injure anyone.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[From.Planet.GetName]上进行考古发掘的时候莫名其妙地激活了一些远古智能人。

那些敌对智能人暂时被牵制住了，但我们仍然无法通过它们。除非让这些机器人彻底停摆，否则我们就必须寻找另一条路线。
texts.en:
The excavations carried out by our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName] have somehow activated several ancient sentinel droids.

The hostile robots have been contained for now, but there is no way past them. Unless they can be neutralized, an alternate route will have to be found.

label.en: They will have to go around.

texts.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个古老的资源贮藏点。他们现在已经开始将这些物资装船运往我们的中央仓库。
texts.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] discovered an ancient cache of resources among the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName]. They are even now in the process of being shipped off to our central stores.

texts.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]不久前在发掘[From.Planet.GetName]上的遗迹时发现了一段隐蔽的隧道！这个意想不到的发现加快了发掘进度。
texts.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] recently found a hidden passage while excavating the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName]! This unexpected discovery has accelerated progress at the dig site.

texts.zh: 你的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]偶然发现了之前在[From.Planet.GetName]进行的一次不幸的探险行动，那是很久以前的事了。我们的人从他们干枯的遗骸中找到了几件稀有文物。
texts.en: Your [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] have stumbled upon an ill-fated previous expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] that perished long ago. Several minor artifacts were recovered from their desiccated remains.

texts.zh: 怒气冲天的争执在[From.Planet.GetName]的考古遗址爆发了出来，几名[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]就如何最好地推进项目同[Root.GetLeaderName]的意见产生了公开的分歧。该遗址的工程进展已经慢的如同蜗牛一般。
texts.en: Tempers are running high at the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName], and several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] are openly disagreeing with [Root.GetLeaderName] about how best to proceed. Progress at the site has been slowed to a crawl.

texts.zh: 最近[Root.GetLeaderName]在[From.Planet.GetName]的考古发掘现场发现了一个小藏宝室！虽然发现的大多数小玩意儿几乎没有实际用途，但它们可值不少能量币。
texts.en: A small hidden treasure chamber was recently uncovered by [Root.GetLeaderName] at the archaeological dig site on [From.Planet.GetName]. Although most of the found trinkets are of little practical use, they have a substantial energy credit value.

texts.zh: 考古人员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报道一种奇怪的疾病正在[From.Planet.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]间传播。首个病例在第一次打开密封室后不久被确认。由于很大一部分团队成员已经无法继续参与考古，遗迹的开发进展已经推迟。
texts.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that a strange sickness has been spreading among the [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName]. The first confirmed cases appeared shortly after a sealed chamber was opened for the first time. With a large part of the team incapacitated, progress has been delayed.

texts.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上的考古探险队发来报告，由于一系列未曾预料的设备故障，工程出现了延期。在拿到替代设备之前，考察工作将暂时停滞。
texts.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has reported delays caused by an unlikely series of equipment malfunctions. Work has been halted momentarily until replacements can be acquired.

texts.zh: 当发掘[From.Planet.GetName]上的遗迹时，[dead_scientist.GetName]消失的无影无踪了。一项由另一个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]领导的广泛的搜寻工作也一无所获。我们必须考虑到最坏的情况。
texts.en: While excavating the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName], [dead_scientist.GetName] recently vanished without a trace. An extensive search by the other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] turned up nothing. We have to assume the worst.

notes.zh: 事件池中权重仅为2；科学家被移出并死亡。
notes.en: Weight only 2 in the pool; the scientist is removed and dies.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上持续的发掘工作出土了一小堆古董物件。[Root.GetLeaderName]在这之中鉴定出了一些稀有文物。
texts.en: Our continued excavations on [From.Planet.GetName] have unearthed a small cache of antique objects. [Root.GetLeaderName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

texts.zh: 一些稀有文物于近期由[Root.GetLeaderName]在[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古站点上发现。它们目前正在运往一个安全的科学设施的途中。
texts.en: Some minor artifacts were recently discovered by [Root.GetLeaderName] at the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName]. They are currently in the process of being shipped to a secure science facility.

texts.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]上遗迹的发掘中，一部分地面最近发生了坍塌，使得我们的一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]跌落到一个小裂口中。幸运的是他们不仅在事故中毫发无伤，还发现了一些稀有文物。
texts.en: A section of floor at the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName] recently gave way, sending several of our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] tumbling down a small chasm. Fortunately they not only emerged unharmed from the incident, but they also found several minor artifacts.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

在我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]能够成功逃生之前，穷凶极恶的野兽撞上了他们。[dead_scientist.GetName]与其他人失散了。
texts.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Before our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] could make their escape, the vicious animals were upon them. [dead_scientist.GetName] was lost along with the others.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

许多[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在[Root.GetLeaderName]能带领幸存者们抵达安全地点前失散了。
texts.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Many [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were lost before [Root.GetLeaderName] could lead the survivors to safety.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

幸运的是，野兽们正处于冬眠，并且它们没有被我们[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]的通过所惊扰。项目的进度正在急速推进中。
texts.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Fortunately, the animals were hibernating and they were not disturbed by the passage of our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]. The project is rapidly moving ahead.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的废墟中发现了一个巢穴，这个巢穴是由该星球的土生大型掠食动物集群建造的。

处理这些凶猛的野兽并不轻松，但是它们挡住了前方唯一的道路。我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]能够寻找到其他路径，但是这将花费一定时间。
texts.en:
A group of large predators indigenous to [From.Planet.GetName] were recently discovered to have made a lair in the ruins being excavated.

Dealing with these vicious animals will not be easy, but they are blocking the only route forwards. Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] can look for an alternate path, but it will take time.

label.en: They will have to go around.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]已经抵达了遗迹的一个高度不稳定的区域。

不幸的是，一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]头上的整块天花板发生了坍塌，当场去世。[dead_scientist.GetName]也在牺牲者之列。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Unfortunately, an entire ceiling collapsed on several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural], killing them instantly. [dead_scientist.GetName] was among them.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]已经抵达了遗迹的一个高度不稳定的区域。

一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]于近期因天花板塌陷而死亡。[Root.GetLeaderName]在废墟中毫发无伤地站了起来，但是站点的工作暂时停止了。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were recently killed when a ceiling collapsed on them. [Root.GetLeaderName] emerged unscathed from the debris, but work at the site has been momentarily halted.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]已经抵达了遗迹的一个高度不稳定的区域。

幸运的是，[Root.GetLeaderName]成功设计出了一种标新立异且杰出卓越的方法，利用复杂的定向能量场阵列来提供结构支撑。我们现在能够安全地进入遗迹的新区域了。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Fortunately, [Root.GetLeaderName] managed to devise an unorthodox and brilliant way of providing structural support with a complex array of directed energy fields. We can now safely access new areas of the ruins.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上工作的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]已经抵达了遗迹的一个高度不稳定的区域。

在我们继续前进之前，支撑系统必须被仔细地添加到地面和天花板。这将是一项艰巨的工作，但是寻找另一条路线会延缓整个项目。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] working on [From.Planet.GetName] have reached a highly unstable section of the ruins.

Supports will have to be carefully added to the floors and ceilings before we can proceed. It will be difficult work, but finding an alternate route would delay the project.

label.zh: 安全第一。稳定这些遗迹。

label.en: They will have to go around.

texts.zh: 古老并且部分被翻译的记录已经在[From.Planet.GetName]上被挖掘的废墟中发现。[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说这份记录包含着一些能对我们科学家有益处的技术细节。
texts.en: Ancient, partially translated records have been discovered amongst the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName]. [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the records contain several technical specifications that may be of value to our scientists.

texts.zh: 大前天晚上，首席考古学家[From.Leader.GetName]报告说看到了令人不安的景象，并且一直被关在自己的房间里直到现在。他们认为是我们这里的某种东西引发的……
texts.en: Three nights ago, chief archaeologist [From.Leader.GetName] reported having a disturbing vision and has been shut away in their quarters until now. They believed the source to be whatever is down here with us...

texts.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

所有人都无能为力 —— 一瞬间，[dead_scientist.GetName] 和其他几个 [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] 被卷入了裂口，直接导致他们死亡。
texts.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

There was nothing anyone could have done - within moments, [dead_scientist.GetName] and several other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were swept through the breach to their deaths.

texts.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

一瞬间，几个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]被卷入了裂口，直接导致他们死亡。幸运的是，[Root.GetLeaderName]当时在空间站的不同区段，但这对调查工作来说仍是一个重大挫折。
texts.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Within moments, several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were swept through the breach to their deaths. Fortunately, [Root.GetLeaderName] was in a different section of the station at the time, but this is nevertheless a significant setback for the investigation effort.

texts.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

幸运的是，由于我们的团队能够逃到空间站未受影响的区域，事故中无人丧生。似乎也没有重要设备损坏，因此调查不会因此面临任何不应有的挫折。
texts.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Fortunately, no lives were lost in the incident, as our team was able to escape to unaffected areas of the station. It seems no vital equipment was damaged either, so the investigation will not face any undue setbacks as a result.

texts.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

幸运的是，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]没有受到伤害，因为它们的建造出来就可以在太空中生存一段时间。因此，他们能够不受阻碍地继续他们的工作。
texts.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Fortunately, our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were unharmed, as they have been built to survive in open space for a time. They were therefore able continue their work undeterred.

texts.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

幸运的是，由于我们的团队能够逃到空间站未受影响的区域，事故中无人丧生。然而，减压的力量损坏了他们一直在工作的几个控制台，需要花费大量资金进行维修。
texts.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Fortunately, no lives were lost in the incident, as our team was able to escape to unaffected areas of the station. However, the force of the decompression damaged several of the consoles they had been working on, and will cost a considerable amount to be repaired.

texts.zh:
我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

幸运的是，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]没有受到伤害，因为它们的建造出来就可以在太空中生存一段时间。然而，减压的力量损坏了他们一直在工作的几个控制台，需要花费大量资金进行维修。
texts.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Fortunately, our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were unharmed, as they have been built to survive in open space for a time. However, the force of the decompression damaged several of the consoles they had been working on, and will cost a considerable amount to be repaired.

label.zh: 我们将提供他们需要的所有资金。
label.en: We shall provide all the funding they need.

label.zh: 这会耽搁我们一段时间。

texts.zh: 我们对[fromfrom.planet.system.GetName]恒星系中空间站的遗迹开展了持续性研究，并在这个过程中发现了少量密藏的古董物品。首席考古学家[root.leader.GetName]在其中发现了几件稀有文物。
texts.en: Our continued study of the remnants of the station in the [fromfrom.planet.system.GetName] system has unearthed a small cache of antique objects. Chief archaeologist [root.leader.GetName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

texts.zh: 当我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]正在调查附近的控制台时，空间站的一部分墙壁突然倒塌。然而，事实证明我们撞了好运，收纳有几个稀有文物的隐藏隔间随即被发现了。
texts.en: A section of the station's walls suddenly collapsed as our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were investigating a nearby console. This proved a fortuitous event however, as a hidden compartment concealing several minor artifacts was revealed.

notes.zh: 只出现在轨道与飞船类遗址池（space_station_random_events、site_spaceship_random_events 等）；同池的爆炸性减压8200–8203与系统锁定8215现已并入本故事。
notes.en: Only in the orbital and spaceship pools (space_station_random_events, site_spaceship_random_events and others); the same pools' explosive decompression 8200-8203 and system lockout 8215 are now part of this story.

texts.zh: 查看空间站的电子设备时，我们的[Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]之一意外触发了其创建者留下的一些仍然有效的安全措施。这导致了在部署正确的对策之前，我们的团队在很长一段时间内都被排除在空间站系统之外。
texts.en: As they were poking through the station's electronics, one of our [Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] accidentally triggered some still-functional security measures left by its creators. As a result, our team were locked out from the station's systems for a considerable time before the right countermeasures could be deployed.

summary.text:
# 考古遗址：发掘意外 / Archaeological Sites: excavation incidents

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：events/ancient_relics_random_site_events.txt:15–1153、1584；common/scripted_effects/archaeology_event_effects.txt:59–112、332–504；events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:3612、4548、6727 · DLC：考古遗址机制属《远古遗物》Ancient Relics（稀有文物奖励需该DLC）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

> 说明（审阅注释）：游戏没有为这组事件命名，标题借用界面原文“考古遗址 / Archaeological Sites”。这些事件不是任何一处遗址的剧情章节，而是所有使用通用事件池的遗址共享的随机插曲。

## 如何开始 How it starts

每个考古遗址阶段由科学家掷骰推进。若一次结果得分≤5（不得线索）且当前阶段已有线索，则有10/130的机会从遗址的随机事件池抽一个事件（archaeology_event_effects.txt:87–105）。大多数遗址使用通用池 all_random_events（332–439）；少数遗址有专属池（如海洋遗址、轨道遗址、部分DLC遗址），在相应遗址导读中说明。

Each dig stage advances by the scientist's rolls. When a roll scores 5 or less (no clue) and the stage already has clues, there is a 10/130 chance to draw one incident from the site's pool (archaeology_event_effects.txt:87–105). Most sites use the generic pool all_random_events (332–439); a few have their own pools (ocean, orbital and some DLC sites), noted in their guides.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

事件之间没有顺序，每次只出现一个，出现时暂时锁定遗址进度：
- 陷阱与险情（六组，每组按 5/25/25/25 抽一种结果）：激光网、哨戒炮、碾压机器人、哨兵机器人、敌对野生动物（仅宜居星球）、不稳定的遗迹。结果分别是科学家与队员身亡（-2线索，科学家死亡）、队员身亡（-1）、化险为夷（+3）、花100能量排除障碍（+3）或绕路（-2）。
- 收获：资源贮藏点（随机一种资源）、隐蔽隧道（+3线索）、迷途的探险队（文物）、藏宝室（800–1800能量）、稀有文物（需远古遗物）、远古记录（三类研究之一）。
- 挫折：争论的考古学家（-3）、传播疾病（-3，非机械帝国）、装备故障（-3；科学家有“敲打维修”特质时可“踢一脚”，各半机会+1或-4）、无影无踪（权重2，科学家失踪）、令人不安的景象（-2，非格式塔；对药物滥用者会移除该特质）、火灾（每帝国一次，非格式塔且使用食物：500食物或-5线索）。
- 专属事件：甲烷爆炸（石中低语）与垃圾山大滑坡（誊录仪）在各自遗址权重20，在其他遗址只要尚未触发过也可能出现。
- 轨道与飞船类遗址的池（space_station_random_events、site_spaceship_random_events）还含：爆炸性减压（四种结果，同样按 5/25/25/25，机械领袖不抽8200、机械所有者种族不抽8201）和系统锁定8215（-3线索；有“敲打维修”特质的领袖可“踢一脚”，各半机会+1或-4）；稀有文物8210也在此池中。

Incidents are unordered; only one appears at a time and it pauses the site:
- Traps and hazards (six sets, each drawn 5/25/25/25): laser grid, sentry guns, crusher-droid, sentinel droids, hostile wildlife (habitable worlds only), unstable ruins. Outcomes: scientist and team killed (-2 clues, scientist dies), team killed (-1), averted (+3), pay 100 energy to clear it (+3) or detour (-2).
- Gains: resource cache (one random resource), hidden passage (+3), lost expedition (artifacts), treasure chamber (800–1800 energy), minor artifacts (Ancient Relics), ancient records (one research field).
- Setbacks: bickering archaeologists (-3), spreading illness (-3, non-machine), equipment malfunction (-3; a Percussive Maintainer may "kick it" for +1 or -4 at even odds), without a trace (weight 2, scientist lost), disturbing vision (-2, non-gestalt; removes Substance Abuser), fire (once per empire, non-gestalt food users: 500 food or -5 clues).
- Specials: Methane Gas Explosion (Whispers in the Stone) and The Great Junkslide (Rubricator) have weight 20 at their own sites and can also appear elsewhere until they have fired once.
- The orbital and spaceship pools (space_station_random_events, site_spaceship_random_events) also hold explosive decompression (four results at 5/25/25/25 again; no 8200 for a robotic leader, no 8201 for a robotic owner species) and system lockout 8215 (-3 clues; a Percussive Maintainer may "kick it" for +1 or -4 at even odds); the minor-artifact find 8210 is in the same pools.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 每组陷阱的四个结果互斥；“付费通过”结果本身还有两个选项。
- 线索增减作用于当前阶段，不改变遗址的阶段顺序。

- The four results of each trap set are exclusive; the pay-to-pass result itself offers two options.
- Clue changes apply to the current stage and never change a site's stage order.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 文本中“考古学家”按帝国类型使用不同称谓（GetArchaeologistPlural）；8080 有两种等效正文。
- 事件条件见上；机械帝国不会出现传播疾病，格式塔不会出现令人不安的景象与火灾。

- "Archaeologists" are named per empire type (GetArchaeologistPlural); 8080 has two equivalent texts.
- Conditions as above: machines never get spreading illness; gestalts never get disturbing vision or fire.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：standard_archaeological_site_on_roll_failed（59–112）、all_random_events 与六个子池、space_station_random_events；ancient_relics_random_site_events.txt 中 8000–8110、8210、13030 的脚本；4006、4021、4078 的脚本与一次性标志；中英文正文已读。
- 结构修正：原草稿把每个意外事件编成一个孤立故事（event-ancrel-8000 等），现合并为一个故事族，按陷阱组标为互斥，整体标为无序事件池；遗址故事不再把它们当作章节。
- 2026-10-13 补充：轨道事件池的 8200–8203、8215 现并入本故事（此前在三处轨道遗址故事里各自出现）；真菌僵尸 8300–8315 与面具事件 15006–15008 属各自遗址的专属池，留在对应遗址故事中。

- Checked: the roll-failure effect, all_random_events and its six sub-pools, space_station_random_events; scripts of 8000–8110, 8210, 13030; 4006, 4021, 4078 and their once-only flags; both languages read.
- Structural fix: the draft made each incident a separate one-card story (event-ancrel-8000 etc.); they are now one curated family with each trap set marked exclusive and the whole marked as an unordered pool; site stories no longer treat them as chapters.
- Added 2026-10-13: the orbital-pool events 8200-8203 and 8215 are now part of this story (before, they appeared separately inside three orbital site stories); fungal zombies 8300-8315 and the jungle failure events 15006-15008 belong to their sites' own pools and stay in those site stories.
